original.statement: ServiceMonitor v1 schema adds optional field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole to explicitly set the service discovery role (Endpoints or EndpointSlice) for target discovery, defaulting to the value in the referenced Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource if unset.

decision.reason: [ev-557f479305b6] shows that from 0.85.0 to 0.86.2, the field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole was added (∅ → string enum Endpoints/EndpointSlice) to the v1 schema of servicemonitors.monitoring.coreos.com, under spec.versions[name=v1]. That matches the subject (group monitoring.coreos.com, kind ServiceMonitor, path spec.serviceDiscoveryRole) and the change type "added". The deterministic CRD and restatement validators confirmed both. The evidence ties the addition to the v1 schema, and nothing shown points to another served version, so keeping version=v1 is supported.
